::: {#def-recursive-set}
#### Recursively defined set

A **recursively defined set** [@wikipedia_recursive_definition]
is a set (@def-set) given by two parts,
named as in @def-recursive-definition:

1. a base case, which names some elements of the set directly;
2. a recursive rule, which says how to build new elements of the set from elements already in it.

The set has no other elements:
each of its elements comes from the base case by applying the recursive rule a finite number of times.

:::
